about: How each tool's spend becomes dollars, and the estimate shown BEFORE a paid run. Measured costs always win over these: a run records what the tool itself reported. Check each provider's price page before publishing.

firecrawl.source: Extract is billed per token; the report uses the credits Firecrawl returns when it returns them

apify.source: Apify reports each run's own usageTotalUsd, which the report uses

browser_use.source: Exact tokens are recorded per run. Fill these three prices from DeepSeek's pricing page (api-docs.deepseek.com) and every run is priced from its own tokens; until then the report marks the cost as an estimate.
